title: Emperor Ssraeshza and the Blood (Seasonal)
summary: The seasonal Emperor retains the Blood activation sequence and linked guard control.
overview: The seasonal Emperor retains the Blood activation sequence and linked guard control.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Maintain guard control before and after the Emperor activates.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Defeat the Blood of Ssraeshza to start the Emperor's three-to-five-minute activation delay.
Both the Blood and Emperor continually bring their eight guards into combat.
The Emperor resets to his protected state on his one-hour reset timer.
Seasonal handling changes loot initialization and victory behavior; no extra health-gated mechanic is implemented here.

notes: Approval E310. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
